skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 34% ATK DMG to a single target in a 3-hit combo. Has a 100% chance to inflict [Internal Injury] on the target (when struck, deals additional Internal Injury DMG equal to 100% of Ringring's ATK; the effect is consumed once triggered).

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 35% ATK DMG to a single target in a 4-hit combo, and restores HP equal to 100% ATK to all allies.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 35% ATK DMG to a single target in a 4-hit combo, and restores HP equal to 120% ATK to all allies.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. At the start of battle, grants 50% Healing rate to all allies for 3 turns.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. At the start of battle, grants 60% Healing rate to all allies for 3 turns.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP by. At the start of battle, grants 70% Healing rate to all allies for 3 turns.

effects.desc: Damage over time based on ST, disappears after activation; Can Detonate to explode.
